criteria.passage: I wouldn’t want to escalate on partial data unless the alarms were clearly confirmed.
criteria.rationale: This indicates the candidate would not treat partial but concerning data as sufficient to trigger action, and would defer action until confirmation. That materially contradicts recognising deviation that requires action under uncertainty.
